pilotDiscrepancies.note: Sprint 47 pilot reported 99 lemmas across 10 manual roots. The morphology source contains 99 distinct lemmas, not 100. The workbook count of 100 was a counting artifact.
pilotDiscrepancies.explanation: The difference between source records and activatable occurrences for roots like علم (854 vs 848), غفر (234 vs 205), and كبر (161 vs 157) is explained by: (1) records with missing lemma fields, (2) records whose lemma was classified as needs-review (e.g. كَانَ under غفر and كبر), (3) duplicate word positions filtered out.

reportInconsistencies.testCount: Sprint 47 report evolved from 45 to 55 tests as activation tests were added. Final count: 55 new tests, 924 total.
reportInconsistencies.acceptanceRate: Sprint 47 report corrected from 97.0% to 92.4% after actual batch execution. The 92.4% figure (4350/4709) is authoritative.
reportInconsistencies.pilotCount: Pilot evaluated 99 distinct lemmas (not 100). The workbook listed 100 but source data has 99.
